_swapComment: MPGRSwapExecutor (contracts/swap) Base Mainnet gate: OPEN - AUTHORIZATION ONLY, NOT DEPLOYED. This reviewed commit sets swapExecutorDeployEnabled=true, which is the explicit owner authorization for at most ONE deployment attempt; it broadcasts nothing and changes no app behaviour by itself. No deployment has occurred: deployments/base-mainnet/mpgr-swap-executor.json does not exist and SWAP_PATH_EXECUTOR_DEPLOYMENT in lib/swap/swap-executor-config.ts is still null, so every swap path route remains non-executable. A broadcast additionally requires ALL of: deploy-swap-executor-trusted.yml dispatched from main with confirm_deployment=DEPLOY_ONE_MPGR_SWAP_EXECUTOR; repo variable SWAP_DEPLOY_REF pinned to this reviewed commit on main; required-reviewer approval of the protected base-mainnet environment; a deployed governance multisig owner (SWAP_EXECUTOR_OWNER variable) that passes the genuine-Safe check; a dedicated fresh nonce-0 deployer key (SWAP_BASE_MAINNET_DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY secret); and a passing scripts/swap-deploy/preflight.sh, which also refuses any second attempt once a manifest exists. Deployment then writes a staging manifest sealed by finalize-manifest.sh with the real tx hash/block; routing activation is a further separate reviewed commit of that manifest into lib/swap/swap-executor-config.ts.
